description: This file defines the NullCoalesceBinary class in the Twig templating engine, implementing the null coalescing binary operator functionality within the expression parsing and compilation process.

classes.name: NullCoalesceBinary
classes.description: Represents the null coalescing operator (??) in Twig's expression syntax, responsible for compile-time code generation of the operator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the null coalescing binary node with left and right expressions, setting up optional tests based on the left expression type.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to evaluate the null coalescing operator, using a test node if present for optimization.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string '??' representing the null coalescing operator during code generation.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Specifies the operand names ('left' and/or 'right') that should be escaped during code generation.
